champions.name: Akshan
champions.tldr: Removed: Can no longer claim Scoundrels if he is dead.; Base damage per shot reduced to 30–110 from 30–130.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akshan was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Undocumented: Second attack range extension
lines.note: Undocumented: Second attack range extension increased to 200 units from 100.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Second attack now more consistently completes when the first attack was executed at maximum range.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Improved predictions for if the first attack will kill the target, including through shields and with his on-hit effects.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer grants an empty placeholder buff after the shield activates.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Can no longer claim Scoundrels if he is dead.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Swings no longer ends early when colliding with turrets at a certain angle.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Cooldown no longer resets when scoring a takedown against an enemy clone.

lines.label: Cooldown when cancelled
lines.note: Cooldown when cancelled reduced to 5 seconds from 15.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Execute against minions now deals true damage instead of physical damage.

lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where a single bullet from Comeuppance dealt unusually lethal damage to Eulogy of the Isles (Yorick)|Maiden}}.
